successCriteria.scenario: Live ship-gate spec 1 and 8: PLOTLOT_LIVE_TESTS=1 runs the never-ingested small-town e2e test; agent discovers source, ingests, produces typed zoning.* claims origin=local_authority plus source_url, runs 8 steps, emits report with evidence_ids OR escalates honestly. Channel CLI pytest. Binary pass test passes and asserts a zoning claim with local_authority origin and non-empty source_url or honest escalation.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C001-shipgate.txt

successCriteria.scenario: Boundary invariants spec 2 enforced in code: a zoning.* claim with origin other than local_authority (e.g. rehabvaluator_concept) raises a validation error, and a cost.* claim with kind=verified_fact raises. Channel CLI pytest -k boundary. Binary pass: both negative assertions raise and message names the violated boundary.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C002-boundary.txt

successCriteria.scenario: Regression gate spec 3,4,5,7: (a) planner refuses step 5 when required zoning.*/parcel.* claim not kind=verified_fact; (b) step 3 routes income approach for >=5 units vs comp approach for <=4 units via typed dispatch; (c) every comp carries source_url+origin (scraped=unknown confidence<=0.5); (d) report validator fails on missing evidence_ids or blurred boundaries. Channel CLI pytest -k 'planner or step3 or comps or report_validator'. Binary pass: all four sub-assertions pass.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C003-regression.txt
